sentences.en: Fadil didn't want to have a face-to-face confrontation with Rami.

sentences.en: I know from experience that such confrontations never end well.
sentences.zh: 我从经验中知道，这样的对抗从来不会有好结果。

sentences.en: Sami didn't want to have a face-to-face confrontation with Farid.
